name: Minecraft
note: Recorded 2026-11-03 on macOS 26. The launcher (Minecraft.app) is a normal app, but the game window belongs to a program just called 'java' with no bundle id and no app icon. The official launcher runs its own copy of Java from ~/Library/Application Support/minecraft/runtime, Prism Launcher from ~/Library/Application Support/PrismLauncher/java. Without this file the game showed as 'java' with the generic program icon in Cmd+Tab and the overview.
